questions.question: What is the use of signage in a shop? / [CO3, CO4]
questions.solution_html:
• What is the use of signage in a shop? [U] / [CO3, CO4]
  • Signage provides information, attracts attention, guides customers, promotes offers, and
  • helps create the store’s brand image.

questions.question: Why is merchandising planning a continuous process? / [CO3, CO4]
questions.solution_html:
• Why is merchandising planning a continuous process? [An] / [CO3, CO4]
  • Merchandising planning is continuous because customer demand, fashion trends, and
  • seasonal requirements change regularly and need constant updating.

questions.question: What is inventory planning? / [CO3, CO4]
questions.solution_html:
• What is inventory planning? [Ap] / [CO3, CO4]
  • Inventory planning is the process of deciding how much stock to keep, when to reorder,
  • and how to avoid stock shortages or excess inventory.

questions.question: What is a “target customer” in visual merchandising? / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• What is a “target customer” in visual merchandising? [K] / [CO1]
  • A target customer is the specific group of customers a store wants to attract and sell
  • products to. They are identified based on age, gender, income, lifestyle, and buying
  • behaviour. Visual merchandisers design store displays, colours, lighting, and themes
  • according to the preferences of the target customers. For example, a youth fashion store uses
  • trendy colours and modern displays to attract young buyers. Understanding target customers
  • helps improve sales and customer satisfaction.

questions.question: How does visual merchandising increase sales and improve store image? / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• How does visual merchandising increase sales and improve store image? [U] / [CO1]
  • Visual merchandising attracts customers through attractive displays, lighting, colours, and
  • store arrangements. It improves product visibility and encourages impulse buying. Proper
  • visual merchandising creates a pleasant shopping atmosphere and helps customers understand
  • product features. It also strengthens brand identity and improves the store image. Attractive
  • window displays and organized interiors encourage customers to enter the store and make
  • purchases.

questions.question: What role do window displays play in shaping a store’s image? / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• What role do window displays play in shaping a store’s image? [U] / [CO2]
  • Window displays are the first point of communication between the store and customers.
  • They attract attention and create curiosity about the products inside. Effective window
  • displays communicate the brand image, seasonal themes, and fashion trends. They help
  • convert passers-by into customers. Attractive displays also create a strong visual identity and
  • improve the store’s reputation.

questions.question: Evaluate the effectiveness of shadow boxes and showroom/boutique displays in promoting merchandise. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Evaluate the effectiveness of shadow boxes and showroom/boutique displays in
  • promoting merchandise. [E] / [CO2]
  • Shadow boxes are small display windows used to highlight special or valuable products like
  • jewellery and accessories. They attract attention through focused lighting and close-up
  • presentation. Showroom and boutique displays create a lifestyle presentation and help
  • customers visualize fashion trends. These displays create emotional appeal and improve
  • customer interest. Both methods effectively increase product visibility and sales.

questions.question: Explain how mannequins help in attracting customers into the store. / [CO3, CO4]
questions.solution_html:
• Explain how mannequins help in attracting customers into the store. [E] / [CO3, CO4]
  • Mannequins act as silent salespersons by displaying garments attractively. They show
  • customers how clothes look when worn and help present fashion trends and styling ideas.
  • Mannequins attract attention from outside the store and encourage customers to enter. They
  • also help in upselling by displaying matching accessories and coordinated outfits. Attractive
  • mannequins improve the visual appeal of the store.

questions.question: Describe the different types of store layouts used in retail stores. / [CO3, CO4]
questions.solution_html:
• Describe the different types of store layouts used in retail stores. [U] / [CO3, CO4]
  • Grid Layout
  • Straight aisles arranged in rows, commonly used in supermarkets.
  • Racetrack Layout
  • Circular pathway guiding customers through the entire store.
  • Free-flow Layout
  • Flexible arrangement allowing creative product placement, common in fashion stores.
  • Boutique Layout
  • Small sections arranged for different product categories, creating an exclusive shopping
  • experience.
  • Proper store layout improves customer movement and product visibility.

questions.question: Explain how merchandising planning supports seasonal themes and promotional layouts. / [CO3, CO4]
questions.solution_html:
• Explain how merchandising planning supports seasonal themes and promotional layouts.
  • [U] / [CO3, CO4]
  • Merchandising planning ensures that the right products are available during seasonal events
  • and promotions. It helps visual merchandisers arrange products according to themes such as
  • Christmas, Valentine’s Day, or festival sales. Proper planning supports attractive displays,
  • avoids stock shortages, and improves coordination between buyers and visual merchandisers.
  • This increases customer interest and sales.

questions.question: Why is availability of merchandise important for visual displays? / [CO3, CO4] [5x6 = 30]
questions.solution_html:
• Why is availability of merchandise important for visual displays? [U] / [CO3, CO4]
  • Availability of merchandise is essential because attractive displays are effective only when
  • products are in stock. Customers may lose interest if displayed items are unavailable. Proper
  • stock availability supports seasonal displays, promotional themes, and customer satisfaction.
  • It also helps maintain the store image and increases sales opportunities.
  • [5x6 = 30]

questions.question: How do visual merchandising strategies, like seasonal or promotional displays, strengthen a store’s image? / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• How do visual merchandising strategies, like seasonal or promotional displays, strengthen
  • a store’s image? [E] / [CO1]
  • Visual merchandising is the art of presenting products attractively to increase sales and
  • improve store image. Seasonal and promotional displays are important visual merchandising
  • strategies that help attract customers and strengthen brand identity.
  • Seasonal Displays-Seasonal displays are arranged according to seasons and festivals such as
  • Christmas, Valentine’s Day, Onam, or summer sales. These displays use suitable colours,
  • props, lighting, and merchandise to create excitement among customers. Seasonal themes
  • make the store look fresh and attractive.
  • Promotional Displays
  • Promotional displays highlight special offers, discounts, or new arrivals. These displays
  • attract customer attention and encourage impulse buying. Promotional signage and creative
  • arrangements help communicate marketing messages effectively.
  • Strengthening Store Image

questions.question: Evaluate how effective window displays create store image, build brand identity, and influence customer buying behaviour. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Evaluate how effective window displays create store image, build brand identity, and
  • influence customer buying behaviour. [E] / [CO2]
  • Window displays are considered the “face” or “visiting card” of a store. They are one of the
  • most powerful tools in visual merchandising.
  • Creating Store Image
  • Window displays create the first impression of the store. Attractive displays communicate the
  • quality, style, and personality of the brand. Customers judge the store based on the
  • appearance of the windows.
  • Building Brand Identity
  • Window displays help communicate brand themes, colours, and fashion trends consistently.
  • Luxury brands use elegant displays, while youth brands use colourful and trendy
  • arrangements. This strengthens brand recognition.
  • Influencing Buying Behaviour

questions.question: Discuss in detail the importance of mannequins in retail stores, including their role as silent salespersons, group display usage, and the need for periodic change. / [CO3, CO4]
questions.solution_html:
• Discuss in detail the importance of mannequins in retail stores,including their role as
  • silent salespersons, group display usage, and the need for periodic change.[U] / [CO3, CO4]
  • Mannequins are one of the most important tools in visual merchandising. They help
  • display garments attractively and communicate fashion trends to customers.
  • Role as Silent Salespersons
  • Mannequins are called silent salespersons because they promote products without speaking.
  • They show customers how garments fit and appear when worn. Customers can easily
  • visualize styles, colours, and combinations.
  • Attracting Customers
  • Mannequins placed in windows and interiors attract attention and encourage customers to
  • enter the store. They improve the visual appeal of displays.
  • Group Display Usage
  • Stores often use mannequins in groups to present coordinated fashion collections. Group
  • displays strengthen fashion themes and create realistic lifestyle presentations.
  • Upselling and Styling
  • Mannequins help in upselling by displaying matching accessories such as bags, shoes, and
  • jewellery along with garments.
  • Need for Periodic Change
  • Mannequins and clothing displays should be changed regularly to avoid monotony and
  • maintain customer interest. Seasonal and promotional updates keep the store fresh and
  • attractive.
  • Types of Mannequins
  • • Realistic
  • • Semi-realistic
  • • Abstract
  • • Semi-abstract
  • • Headless mannequins
